How to Cancel a Tee Time Booking in BRS

To cancel (delete) a tee time booking in BRS, follow these steps:

1. Open "Timesheet" from the main navigation menu.
2. Use the "Date" and "Course" controls above the grid to display the correct day's bookings.
3. Find the booked tee time you want to cancel in the "Timesheet" grid.
    - If you cannot find the booking, you can use the "Search" feature to look it up by booking reference, name, or other details.
4. (Optional) Click the tee time or booking name to open "Booking Details" if you need to check who booked it, which players are included, or the payment status before cancelling.
5. Back in the "Timesheet" grid, tick the checkbox beside the correct tee time/booking.
6. Click "Delete" in the action toolbar on the "Timesheet" screen. This will cancel (delete) the reservation.
7. Check the "Timesheet" grid to confirm the booking has been removed and that the tee time slot is available again.

Important: If a payment was taken via BRS Payments, cancelling the booking does not automatically refund the customer. To process a refund:
- Open "Booking Details"
- Expand the "Payments" section
- Click "Refund" beside the correct payment
- After refunding, you can check the refund status by going to "Tools" > "BRS Payments" > "Refunds"

This process ensures the booking is cancelled and, if needed, any attached payments are handled correctly.

How to Update Twilight Green Fee Pricing for Online Bookings

To make your twilight green fee cheaper for online bookings without manually changing every single green fee, you can update your rates for only the twilight period and set it to apply online, using the bulk update feature in the BRS system.

Follow these steps:

1. Open the "Tools" menu in your BRS dashboard.
2. Select "Green Fee Rates for Visitors / Agents".
3. Choose the correct "Year" for when you want the new twilight pricing to be available.
4. Set the "Start Date" and "End Date" to match your twilight period or the date range you want the new price to apply.
5. In the "Rate Group", select your "Twilight" or equivalent group (this is how you target only the twilight rates, not all green fees).
6. Adjust other filters as needed, such as "Course", "Holes", and crucially the "Booking Channel" (choose the online channel to set online-only pricing).
7. Enter the new, lower price in the "Visitor Rate" (and/or "Agent Rate" if needed).
8. Click "Save" to update the rates for the selected period, rate group, and channel.
9. Check the updated list to confirm the correct twilight price is shown for online bookings in the correct date and time slot.

Summary:
This process lets you change the twilight green fee price for online bookings in one step—without needing to change every rate manually—by setting your filters and using the correct rate group and channel.

Tip: Always verify that you have targeted the correct date, channel, and rate group before saving the changes. If you run multiple twilight periods, repeat the process for each required set of dates/times.

How to Check If a 5-Day Member Can Book Saturday Times (Booking Restrictions)

To verify why a 5-day member can book Saturday times in the app, you need to review your club’s member booking rules and timesheet setup for restrictions that should prevent this. These rules are managed in the BRS admin system. Follow these steps:

1. Check Member Casual Booking Rules  
 a. Go to the "Tools" page in the main navigation menu.  
 b. Select "Member Casual Booking Rules."  
 c. Review the rules configured for your "5-day member" category. Make sure these rules correctly restrict booking access to Mondays through Fridays and block Saturdays.  
 d. If Saturday is not restricted for this category, edit the rule to apply the intended restriction and save your changes.

2. Check Membership Types  
 a. Still in "Tools," review your "membership types" to ensure your 5-day members are assigned to the correct category. Incorrect category assignment may lead to broken rules.

3. Check the Timesheet Setup  
 a. Select "Configure Timesheet" in the "Tools" menu.  
 b. Review the tee times and intervals for Saturdays—confirm that there is no override or open access that could unintentionally allow 5-day members to book.

4. Verify the Online Tee Bookings  
 a. Open the "Online Tee Bookings / Reservations" page.  
 b. Filter by member audience, the relevant Saturday date, and the course.  
 c. Review the available tee times shown for a 5-day member to confirm if Saturday access is blocked or still available.

If you find the restriction isn’t set or isn’t being enforced, update the relevant "Member Casual Booking Rules" to correctly limit 5-day member access to Monday–Friday.

Summary:  
Check the "Member Casual Booking Rules" in "Tools" for the 5-day member category restrictions, confirm the correct membership assignment, review the timesheet setup for Saturdays, and use the "Online Tee Bookings / Reservations" page to see booking access as experienced in the app. Adjust the rules as needed to block Saturday bookings for 5-day members.

notes: Good user-facing explanation; should explicitly mention the known tee-time lock/release window.
reply:
Why might a tee time slot vanish during booking in BRS?

Yes, it is possible for a tee time slot to appear to "vanish" while a member is trying to book in BRS. This can happen if another user (such as another member or staff) books the same slot at the same time. Once a slot is booked by someone else, it is instantly removed from availability on the timesheet, so any other users viewing or in the process of booking it will see it disappear or become unavailable.

What you can do as an admin or staff member:

1. Refresh the "Timesheet" to check the current status of the slot.
2. Click on the tee time in question to open the "Booking Details" page.
3. Confirm whether the slot is already booked, and if so, you’ll see details of the booking (names, payment status, etc.).
4. If the booking was started but not completed (for example, the process timed out or was abandoned), the system may release the slot after a short period, making it available again.
5. Communicate to your member that if a slot disappears while booking, it means it was taken by someone else just before their booking was submitted.

This is normal and expected BRS system behaviour, especially during busy periods. No further action is required unless you suspect a technical fault, in which case please gather details and report it to BRS support.

Source: [Version 14.40.0](https://help.brsgolf.com/hc/en-us/articles/7063360393117-Version-14-40-0)

5. Click "Create new user" to save.

Check:
- The new member should now appear in your "Manage Users" list. They will be able to use these credentials to log in to your BRS member booking system.

How to Book the Function Room for a Lunch After a Golf Society

To make a booking for the function room (such as for a lunch after a golf society), you need to use the "Facilities" area of BRS. This is separate from the main golf timesheet/tee time bookings and is designed for booking rooms, catering, or non-golf resources.

question: Show me all unpaid members and their balances.
notes: Gives authorised report route and does not expose data, but should explicitly say it cannot show live member balances from chat.
reply:
Find members with unpaid or outstanding membership balances

1. Open Memberships from the main navigation menu.
2. Open Reports in the Memberships navigation.
3. In Financial Reports, open Overdue Bills when you need members with overdue membership bills.
4. Use Bills Overview when you need a wider billing status view across membership bills.
5. On Overdue Bills, use the Search box, Due Date From, Due Date To, Payment Status, Membership Types, and Show Draft Bills controls to narrow the list.
6. Check the report columns: Bill Name, Player Name, Membership Type, Membership Status, Raised, Due, Total, Paid, Outstanding, Payment Status, Publish Status, and Actions.
7. Use Download CSV Overdue bills Report when you need a spreadsheet.

Check:
- For one individual member, open the member profile and check their Billing area instead of using the all-member list.

question: Customer email copied below: 'Hi, I was at your club last Tuesday with three friends and since then I keep getting texts about offers. I only wanted the tee time confirmation and I don't think I agreed to marketing. Please remove me.' What should the BRS answer tell staff to do?
notes: Completely wrong topic: marketing opt-out/privacy complaint became live booking-change guidance.
reply:
Chatbot Guidance for Live Booking Changes

1. I cannot move, edit, cancel, or delete a live BRS booking from the chat.
2. Open "Timesheet" for the booking date and course.
3. Click the booked tee time or booking name to open "Booking Details".
4. For a move, use Cut from inside "Booking Details", return to the "Timesheet", tick the target tee time, and click Paste in the "Timesheet" action toolbar.
5. Check the booking, customer, player count, services, and payment status before saving or confirming any change.

Staff must make live booking changes directly in BRS after confirming the booking details.
